architectury-api:
Talk to us on Discord!

An intermediary api aimed to ease developing multiplatform mods.

 

 What is Architectury API

Architectury API is an api to abstract calls to fabric api and forge api as both loader has different implementations of
what can be perceived as the same thing.

Architectury API updates regularly, with new hooks and features. Currently contains over 90 events hooks, networking
abstraction, loader calls abstraction, game registry abstraction and an easy to use @ExpectPlatform annotation (Only
works on static methods).

 Do I really need this API?

Architectury API is only one part of the architectury ecosystem, Architectury Plugin is the gradle plugin enabling
all this multiplatform actions.

Architectury API is optional for projects built on architectury, you may create your architectury project with just
Architectury Plugin.

 Advantages of Architectury

- Open sourc

About

Modern co-op games often allow players to communicate via "pings" to mark in-game locations. 
This simple mod provides such pinging mechanism for the fabric and forge mod loaders.

Default keybind is "Mouse5" aka "Forward" to ping. Hold "Tab" (Player List) to see player names on pings. 
The settings can be changed via /pingwheel config or Mod Menu. 
Read the Wiki for additional information.

If you are looking to use the mod on Bukkit servers, you can install our official Plugin.

thermoo:
Thermoo - Temperature and Environment API

 

 

Thermoo is a temperature and environment library mod for Minecraft. It is meant to help provide compatibility between mods and datapacks that use temperature as a core mechanic, such as Frostiful or Scorchful. Using this mod on its own will have no gameplay or visual effects. It is designed to be used by Mods written in both Java and Kotlin, as well as Datapacks through Commands and other registries.

 Developer Features and Wiki

Thermoo provides a number of useful features for developers of temperature mods and datapacks, including:
 A unified framework for dealing with Temperature and Wetness/Soaking
 Cross-compatibility with other Thermoo mods, without needing to specify direct compatibility patches
 Powerful datapack-based Environment API
 Data-driven temperature effects
 Event-driven configuration of default item attributes

common-network:
Common Networking

This library mod aims to unify networking and packet registration between mod loaders so that Developers using Jared's MultiLoader Template only need to deal with networking in the common module. But, it is not limited to only usage with MultiLoader. This can be used in other projects as well.

This also allows your mod to be loader agnostic. The way packets are built and constructed, Forge version of the mod on the client, can talk to the Fabric version on the server. Though you will need to create your own handshake packet.

 Editor

- Four canvas sizes, from 7x7 up to 63x63
- A pen and a circle tool
- Mirror your strokes horizontally, vertically or both
- Undo and redo
- Save the crosshairs you like and load them back later

 

Shortcuts in the editor:

- S shows or hides the guide lines
- Hold Shift to lock a stroke to one direction
- Z and Y undo and redo
- W switches the mirror mode
- C switches between pen and circle

 More crosshairs

- An elytra indicator below the crosshair while you're wearing one (1.21.1+)

 Options

collision-damage:
Fairly simple mod that adds acceleration-based collision damage. Normally this exists in Minecraft, except it only works when the player is wearing an Elytra and they fly into a wall.

This mod reworks the calculations and applies it to the player, damaging them when there is a large sudden negative acceleration while hitting a block. This works best with mods such as Grappling Hook, Dodging, etc. but also works simply if the player has a high speed, such as from enchants and potions.

There is config options to change the threshold of how fast the player has to hit a wall before it begins doing damage, as well as a multiplier for the damage on top of that. There is also an optional toggle to make the collision damage instead be applied as fall damage, in which case things that affect/prevent fall damage such as Feather Falling should affect the collision damage as well. (Off by default)

This is fork of Cerulan which is actually a fork of Icterine. Original maintainer didn't update it for a year, so i updated to modern versions as a fork of Cerulean under same name. 

Cerulean is a mod that optimizes Minecraft's advancement checking system, specifically the laggy InventoryChangeTrigger, which can cause heavy lag in modpacks with lots of modded advancements. Cerulean is fork of Icterine, updated to 1.21.1 by Txni with additional features.

Aside from being updated to 1.21.1, Cerulean adds an option to only process advancements every few ticks, which is the strategy used by mods like Achievements Optimizer (which does not work with the original Icterine). This option is handled in a way that ensures the first time an item is picked up per player, it is always processed for achievements--preventing cases where advancements would stall until you moved items around.

 Summary

end-gateway-warps:
Despite being the endgame dimension, The End is lacking in several areas. While some mods add new world generation and mobs, there is still another flaw that needs to be addressed: entering The End takes you to the same spot every time, so making a base or build deep in the End Wilds is discouraged as it requires you to travel there every time. Even if you use a mod that makes The End interesting to explore, what's the point of all these cool areas if you can't get back to them reasonably?

In the End Wilds, you can occasionally find End Gateways that let you teleport back to the main island. With this datapack/server-side mod, players can link themselves to a gateway of their choice, which will be their entry point to The End until they choose a different gateway or disable the functionality.

 Functionality: When a player drops a respawn anchor on top of a bedrock block for an End Gate

尽管是残局维度，但The End在几个方面有所欠缺。虽然一些模组增加了新的世界生成和怪物，但还有另一个缺陷需要解决：每次进入尽头都会带你到同一个地方，所以在尽头荒野深处建立基地或建筑是不鼓励的，因为它要求你每次都要到那里去。2即使你使用了一个让尽头探索起来很有趣的模组，如果你不能合理地回到这些凉爽的地方，那么这些凉爽的地方又有什么意义呢？ 在末日荒野中，你偶尔会发现末日之门，让你传送回主岛。通过这个数据包/服务器端模式，玩家可以将自己链接到他们选择的一个网关，这将是他们进入末日的入口，直到他们选择另一个网关或禁用该功能。 功能：当玩家在基岩方块上投下一个复活锚来制造一个终点门时

fast-recipe-search:
This mod significantly accelerates recipe lookup. Its mechanism involves building a tree based on hash codes of recipe ingredients, enabling rapid identification during searches. Compared to the original method of matching recipes one by one, it achieves a speedup of over 10 times, with the performance gap widening as the total number of recipes increases.
Furthermore, the mod Core library provides a high-performance recipe tree API. Other mods can also utilize this library, and since it doesn't rely on Minecraft code, even non-Minecraft projects can use it.
该模组大大加快了菜谱查找的速度。其机制是基于菜谱成分的哈希码构建一棵树，可以在搜索过程中快速识别。与原来的逐个匹配菜谱的方法相比，它实现了10倍以上的加速，并且随着菜谱总数的增加，性能差距越来越大。 此外，模组 Core库提供了一个高性能的配方树API。其他模组也可以使用这个库，因为它不依赖于Minecraft代码，即使是非Minecraft项目也可以使用它。

The main goal of scafall is to provide a lightweight wrapping solution for creating cross-platform APIs. 
A secondary goal is to provide utils for the most used parts of each platform, such as Tasks & Scheduling or Kotlin-specific convenience utils for libraries like Adventure.

Note: Scafall is a development library not meant to be used by players or provide gameplay features. Other plugins/mods may require it as a dependency.

 Proxy Interfaces
Scafall avoids wrapping every Platform/Minecraft feature by providing simple wrapper interfaces, that are only used as a kind of proxy. 

1. The API (created by the plugin/mod dev) accepts wrappers as arguments (e.g. ScafallItemStack ) in functions. 
2. The implementations of those functions unwrap() the wrapper arguments to the native Minecraft object, work with those (e.g., ItemStack ), and wrap() any return value.
3. Other Mods/Plugins wrap()

SCP-017 is a small, humanoid anomaly, spawning exclusively in dark areas. It stalks nearby players and emits black smoke particle. Exposure to light causes it to emit even more smoke particles and extinguish nearby torches. When angered, SCP-017 reveals glowing eyes and intensifies its smoke output. Attacking a player causes the entity to grow in size, surrounding its victim in smoke and inflicting multiple debuffs including Blindness, Darkness, Slowness, Mining Fatigue, and Weakness. Though with it's low health, it deals high damage and regenerates if it kills an entity, shrinking back to its normal size.

totemclean:
TotemClean

 TotemClean is a lightweight client-side mod that removes your own totem of undying activation animation and particles - keeping only the sound.

 What does it do?

When you use a totem of undying, vanilla Minecraft plays a loud flash animation that covers your entire screen and fills the air around you with green and yellow particles for several seconds. While it looks spectacular the first time, it quickly becomes disorienting - especially in PvP or other fast-paced situations where you need to keep your vision clear right after surviving.

TotemClean removes:
- The fullscreen totem animation (the flashing overlay)
- Your own totem particles (the green/yellow burst around you)

TotemClean keeps:
- The totem activation sound
- All potion effects granted by the totem
- Other players' totem particles - so you can still tell when someone nearby pops a totem

--------------------------------
 This little datapack/mod only adds two things: 
- Hands at the armor stand 
- Armor stand customization 
---------------------------------

Now, if you put an armor stand, he will immediately have arms. To hide its arms, rename a stick to NoHand using an anvil and place that stick in the armor stand's hand.

 ashh.ignore is a persistent Minecraft entity tag that tells ASHH to leave that stand alone. Its arm state and held items are not changed by ASHH, even if its main hand holds a NoHand stick.

To exclude the armor stands:
/tag @e[type=minecraft:armor stand] add ashh.ignore

To remove the exclusion:
/tag @e[type=minecraft:armor stand] remove ashh.ignore

An administrator can restore the armor stands arms with:
/execute as @e[type=minecraft:armor stand] run function armor stand have hands:enable arms

This also removes its ashh.ignore exclusion and hidd

Available for Fabric and Forge . Choose a file marked for your exact Minecraft version and loader from the Versions tab.

 The apocalypse, your way

 Registry Dump

[ ][DOWNLOAD]
[ ][ISSUES]

Dump all IDs of known registry entries into JSON files.
 
/dump registry
 
A specific registry can also be specified, by default all registries are exported.
 
/dump registry minecraft:item
 

The JSON files are created under dump within your minecraft directory and take the following shape:
 
dump/[registry key]/[namespace].json
 

For example
 
dump/banner pattern/minecraft.json
dump/item/brazier.json
dump/worldgen/biome/minecraft.json
dump/worldgen/biome/environmental.json
 

The content of these files is a simple JSON array containing all keys withing that registry/namespace combo.

Mob Spawn Control

Mob Spawn Control is a server-side Fabric mod for controlling Minecraft mob spawning through configuration and in-game admin commands. It supports per-mob spawn rules, global category caps, spawn replacement, attribute scaling, loot scaling, experience scaling, biome spawn additions, and hot-reloaded JSON configuration.

 What this mod does

Mob Spawn Control intercepts mob spawning and applies configurable rules before a mob is allowed to enter the world. It can:

- Allow or deny mobs globally, per dimension, per biome, or per spawn type.
- Apply spawn-chance percentages globally, per dimension, or per biome.
- Restrict spawning by Y height, light level, spawn block, time, world age, weather, player distance, and distance from world origin.
- Replace one mob with another when the original mob would have spawned.
- Remove all existing entities of a banned mob from load

Faster Shadow Mapper is a really lightweight mod that prevents unneeded things from rendering during the shadow pass.

 Compatible shader mods:
- Iris (built-in since 1.11.2+)
- Beryl 
- Oculus 
- Optifine 

 How it works
During the shadow pass, for opaque models, the color of the model won't have any visual change, a blue car and a red car both cast the same shadow, no matter their color.
So what this mod does is it prevents things like the text on signs, the banner patterns, the enchantment glint etc from rendering during the shadow pass.
It only improves performances when some of those are visibles.

The Shadow Tapes is a psychological horror mod that transforms Minecraft into a place of dread, silence, and unseen watchers. Strange entities lurk deep underground, stalking players from the shadows. They do not attack immediately — they observe. You may never see them, but you’ll feel them. The deeper you go, the stronger the presence becomes.

This mod introduces a growing sense of paranoia through ambient effects, eerie sounds, and subtle environmental changes. Creatures are designed not just to hunt, but to haunt — following players silently, appearing briefly in the distance, and vanishing before they can be confronted. Their behavior is unpredictable, their motives unknown.

You are not alone. You were never alone.

fishing-tick-fix:
Fishing Tick Fix

In vanilla, when a fishing line is cast, the game rolls a random time after which a fish will bite, then 
subtracts 5 seconds from that for each level of the "Lure" enchantment on the fishing rod. If this modified
time would be negative, it rolls for a new delay on the next tick, and repeats this process until it is 
positive.

Using this mod, if the delay (after modifications like Lure) is negative, it is instead set to 1 tick and not rerolled.

 ...Why?

- Lure levels above 1 are buffed slightly - for example, Lure 2 effectively gets a 20% chance to catch a fish immediately, rather than all times between 0 and 20 seconds being equally likely
- Lure levels above 5 are guaranteed to catch fish immediately, whereas they get stuck rerolling the delay every tick in vanilla (and therefore never catch a fish) because it would always be negative

transite:
Transite, the shifting material. Found in isolated clusters where stone metamorphizes into deepslate, tools and armor made from this metal are not content with the form they are given. Transite tools continuously take on aspects of other tools, sacrificing part of their given form's function for that of another. btw-addon-forgiving-campfire:
Forgiving Campfire Addon
A Better Than Wolves addon that makes the campfire’s overfuel mechanic more forgiving.

 Changes
The addon removes the mechanic from BTW CE 3.0 which locks campfires into burning with a large frame for a while after getting overfueled. This allows some room for error, and your cook isn't instantly doomed if you slightly overfuel your campfire. On the other hand, it now takes much less time for food to get burnt on a campfire, so you should still take good care not to overfuel your campfire too much. 

 Installation
You can install the addon by placing the release jar in the mods folder of a BTW CE 3.0 client or server.

 Copyright
The Forgiving Campfire Addon is available under the CC0 1.0 license, allowing you to do with it as you wish without considering my copyright.
cobblemon-fossil-deposits:
Cobblemon Fossil Deposits

Adds fossil deposits to sandstone, red sandstone, and deepslate. These basically behave like ore blocks (but without necessarily forming classical veins), including support for Silk Touch and Fortune enchantments (note that the latter is currently broken in vanilla because of 🪲 this bug, so this mod includes a bugfix for that to make it work).

The generation of those blocks should be relatively rare, while still making fossils more accessible than by purely relying on archaeology drops.

Fossil beds in deepslate will be rarer and smaller than those in either kind of sandstone.

 API

Included is a new event ( FossilExcavationEvents.FOSSIL EXCAVATED ) that fires when a fossil deposit drops a fossil, so other mods can react to that as they wish. The drop is not cancellable, but it is possible to modify the dropped item stack.

This mod removes the need of air blocks when spawning a creature with structure-based system. 
 
 
 (The block in question now can be any block) 

 The mod also tries to spawn the golem in a safe position. 
 
 
 
Because of the golem's hitbox, it can be suffocated as soon as it spawns if it is next to a wall or blocks at head height. So there are two options you can choose to avoid this.

These features can be enabled/disabled as you want in the config file, and yes, both can be enabled: 
 

 The mod allows the golem to do the following: 
1» Be inmune to suffocation until the golem hits the ground, so lets the code wait until it's useful. 
2» Teleport to the best direction (also corners), where fewer blocks are. 
3» Break those blocks if needed. 
 (The golem will ignore directions with unbreakable blocks and do nothing if there are only unbreakable blocks.)

worse-swimming:
Worse Swimming

Minecraft's movement code is complicated and has some problems.

One of these problems is that because of the way swimming is implemented, effects like Slowness and Speed barely affect swim speed at all.

I think this makes swimming too good. So I made this mod to make it worse.

 How it works

Movement on land applies a slowdown to entities based on the friction of the block the entity is moving on. Swimming has no friction component, which makes it easy to build up so much velocity in a tick that Slowness can't actually slow you down.

Worse Swimming adds two new friction components to the swimming movement calculation, once for movement when not immersed in water ("wading") and one for movement when completely immersed ("swimming"). The default values make wading considerably slower than swimming, but both can be adjusted in the configuration.

screenshot-location:
Screenshot Location
 
 
 

This mod allows configuring the location screenshots are saved though a global config. 
Useful for using a global screenshots directory.

By default, the config for the mod is stored in a global location outside the Minecraft instance folder. The mod only needs to be configured once, as every instance uses the same config.

 Usage
Download the mod (developers see below), launch the game, join a world, run the /screenshot-location getConfigLocation command and copy the path. 
Paste that path into your file explorer of choice to open the folder and then open the main.json config file in an editor.

Set enabled to true to enable the mod. 
If you want, you can customize the location. You can use user directories by specifying their name like ${pictureDir} or ${homeDir} , environment variables with ${env:VARIABLE NAME} and jvm properties with ${jvm:property.name} .

create-tfmg-network-fix:
On dedicated servers, several TFMG recipe types do not serialize their custom fields into the network buffer. When the server sends recipes to clients, these fields arrive empty:

- VatMachineRecipe loses machines , allowedVatTypes , and minSize — JEI displays vat recipes without machine modules (mixer, centrifuge, electrodes) and without material overlays (firebrick, cast iron).
- IndustrialBlastingRecipe loses hotAirUsage — blast furnace recipes show incorrect hot air requirements.

This only affects dedicated servers. In singleplayer, recipes are loaded directly from JSON, so all fields are present.

 How it works

The mod uses Mixin to inject into the writeAdditional(FriendlyByteBuf) and readAdditional(FriendlyByteBuf) methods of both recipe classes. The missing fields are appended at the tail of the network buffer. No original TFMG code is replaced — the existing logic runs as-is.

Eslium is a project to predict more things client-side.
For example, if you want to use a Crystal, you must wait for the server validation for it to appear.

Predicted spawn packets are never replayed, which also prevents ghost entities when the server changes the spawn data.

An Overview

Find yourself in this new world, peppered with meteors, and many a hostile creature, perhaps your newfound abilities and skills will come to your aid and let you rise to the challenge that you will face going forth.

The goal being to avoid being a "Kitchen-Sink" pack, Evolve aims to provide a nice (and possibly heavy-handed?) upgrade to the experience. From technology, both classic and futuristic with Create and AE2, to revamping core parts of the game with End Remastered and Origins.
Evolve aims to create a fresh experience whilst retaining 90% of the familiarity as a result most of the mods included aren't mandatory for progression and can be completely ignored should they not fit a chosen playstyle.

Evolve is multiplayer focused, with additions like Simple Voice Chat, Lithium, and Ferrite Core to attempt to allow a one stop shop for an interesting multiplayer session.

概述 在这个新的世界里找到你自己，充满了流星和许多敌对的生物，也许你新发现的能力和技能会帮助你，让你面对你将要面对的挑战。 Evolve的目标是避免成为一个“厨房水槽”包，旨在提供一个很好的（可能是沉重的？）升级的经验。从技术，无论是经典的还是未来的创造和AE 2，到改造游戏的核心部分与结束重制和起源。 《进化》的目标是创造一种全新的体验，同时保留90%的熟悉度，因此大多数模组都不是强制性的，如果它们不适合所选的游戏风格，可以完全忽略。 进化是多人游戏的重点，与补充，如简单的语音聊天，锂，和铁氧体核心，试图让一个有趣的多人会话一站式商店。

The World That Forgot Itself 

There was once only one world.

Or at least, that is what the Archive says.

Long before your arrival, a civilization known only as the Archivists discovered something beneath reality: a structure older than life, older than the world, perhaps older than time.

They called it the Archive.

Everything that existed had an Entry.

Every creature.

Every material.

Every place.

Every law of nature.

Every method by which one thing could become another.

The Archivists learned that the Archive did not merely describe reality.

It defined it.

To know the true pattern of something was to gain power over its existence.

And so they began to catalogue everything.

At first, their work brought prosperity.

Disease could be understood. Creatures could be protected. Matter could be transformed. Entire ecosystems could be preserved in perfect detail.

Then came magic.

Version 3.1 is released.
All versions from 1.20 onward are now supported.
 Coming soon!
- Dark Mode: A standalone "Dark Mode" project

 
 Why the Versioning Change and Other Updates? 

I originally switched to version 26.1 to align with the current release year. However, I realized this creates unnecessary confusion since year-based tags easily get mixed up with actual Minecraft version numbers.

With plans to support older Minecraft releases, a title like "GUI Overhaul 26.1 (1.16–1.20.1) Default" becomes messy and misleading. Additionally, keeping both Default and Dark Mode within the same project caused issues: many third-party launchers automatically download the latest file (whether Default or Dark) and ignore the other option entirely.

To solve this, the upcoming release reverts to a standard 3.1 versioning scheme and officially splits the project into two separate resource packs.

Custom Damage Overlay Color

This resource pack allows to change overlay color of all entities when they take damage. By defult this resource pack changes it to green, as an example.

 Versions: 1.17 — 1.21.11 

 Works with both Optifine and Sodium .
---
 How to change the color
Go into the resource pack and open a file assets/minecraft/shaders/include/change damage overlay.glsl , choose a color and put it into the second line of the file. For example if you want to change the color to purple ( AA00FF ) with 50% transparency, the second line of the file would look like this:
 js
vec4 RGBColor = vec4(170,0,255,127);
 
And if you want cyan ( 00FFFF ) color with the same transparency as in vanilla, it would look like this:
 js
vec4 RGBColor = vec4(0,255,255,178);

About :
------------
This pack is a continuation of Doku's RPG,
a texture pack by Doku, it was the initial inspiration for Gerudoku and several other remix packs, Doku's RPG was discontinued in 2010.

in 2014 Handsome Dan started a continuation project called Doku RPG: Faithful Continuation,
it had a few items and new blocks, but was discontinued in 2015 due to lack of time,
most of Doku RPG: Faithful Continuation is used within this pack.

the original plan for this continuation was to avoid using anything made for Gerudoku and parts of Dokucraft, however I realized that I would never finish the pack if I didn't use a few parts from them, the original version of Doku's RPG didn't have items or mobs and the task of making nearly 14 years worth of textures all at once was a little too daunting, so I've tried to use as few as possible while updating the pack through each version of minecra

all-netherite-block:
The "Unfindable" Strategy 
- In Minecraft, blocks like Bedrock, Dirt and Stone have natural texture rotations and patterns that are tied to specific coordinates. High-level "griefers" can use software to analyze the pattern of a single stone block in your background and reverse-calculate your exact X, Y, Z coordinates. By replacing these foundational blocks with the Netherite Block texture, this pack effectively:
 - Obfuscates the Grid: It removes the unique visual "fingerprints" of natural terrain that hunters use to track players.
 - Standardizes Surfaces: Whether you are in the deep slate layers or walking on end stone, the uniform Netherite texture masks the natural rotation data, making pattern recognition impossible.
 - Protects Your Stash: Your base's location remains a mystery even if you accidentally show a wall or floor during a live stream.
- Key Security Features 
 - Universa

“不可见”战略 - 在Minecraft中，像基岩、泥土和石头这样的方块都有自然的材质旋转和图案，这些图案与特定的坐标有关。高级的"悲伤者"可以使用软件分析背景中单个石头方块的图案，并反向计算出精确的X，Y，Z坐标。通过将这些基础方块替换为Netherite Block材质，这个包有效地： - 模糊网格：它消除了猎人用来追踪玩家的自然地形的独特视觉“指纹”。 - 标准化曲面：无论您是在深层板岩层中还是在端石上行走，均匀的Netherite材质都会掩盖自然旋转数据，使模式识别变得不可能。 - 保护您的隐藏物品：即使您在直播过程中意外显示了墙壁或地板，您的基地的位置仍然是个谜。 - 关键安全特性 - universa

For a preview of the pack, check the Gallery tab. 

 Overview
A little something I made for myself. Wynngineer's Vision is a resource pack that retextures Wynncraft's brand new and flashy GUIs, replacing the wooden/paper/near-plastic theme with a clean blue interface, along with shiny gold and yellow elements. Some machinery attached.

Some UI elements of the Wynntils and Wynnventory mods are also retextured.

People complained the new style looked too "polished", which clashed with Wynncraft's more medieval style. So it's about time I made it corporate level of polished.

 Requirements

For this pack to work on Wynncraft, you need one of the following:

- Server Pack Unlocker 
- Serverpack Priority 

Serverpack Priority puts the server pack at lowest priority by default while the former doesn't, but both mods allow you to override it with whatever resource packs you wish.

 ALTERNATIVEL

- Significantly reduce redundancies within the block textures

- Greatly increase the building opportunities from blocks that often get overlooked

- Reduce the unintentional texture repetition effect without heavy reliance on noise or random block variants by focusing on patterns that seamlessly splice together and proper shading

- Identify colors missing from the game and the best texture to go with that color while maintaining balance with what feels appropriate for the block in accordance with its fit in the game

- Maintain the highest quality of block text

顾名思义，Kai Fixes Sand改进了Minecraft中沙子和相关方块的材质，使它们更适合用作积木。 Kai Fixes Minecraft带来的概念是： 显著减少方块材质内的冗余 - 极大地增加了从经常被忽视的区方块构建的机会 - 通过关注无缝拼接在一起的图案和适当的阴影，减少无意的材质重复效果，而无需严重依赖噪波或随机方块变体 - 确定游戏中缺少的颜色和与该颜色搭配的最佳材质，同时根据游戏中的适合度，保持与适合积木的感觉的平衡 - 保持方块文本的最高质量 - Maintain the highest quality of block text

A custom Minecraft shader that renders the world using colored ASCII characters in real time.

CommandBridge is a cross-server command execution plugin for Minecraft networks running on Velocity. Set up your network and build commands through a browser GUI, or write YAML scripts directly on the proxy. CB registers and dispatches those commands across your connected servers over WebSocket or Redis.

A player runs /lobby on a backend, the proxy picks it up. An admin runs /alert on Velocity, your selected backends execute it. Command delivery does not depend on a player being online to carry plugin messages.

 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 

 

 

 Set up your network in the browser

Run /cb setup on Velocity and open the link it gives you. On a fresh install, CB prints a setup link in the console automatically.

The page walks you through naming your proxy, choosing WebSocket or Redis, configuring the connection, and adding your backend servers. Review the settings, then run the confirmation
